author_input.actual_formulas: Weighted Schatten traces, disjoint-fiber frame bound, restricted ambient Gram pairing, list falling factors, enlarged root bijection/multiplicity, first-row line densities and nonunit-H Fourier completion.

overlapping_fibers_witness.interpretation: Without disjoint fibers, the maximum individual norm alone cannot bound the sum of outer products.

trace_and_root_vectors.assurance: Exact finite Fraction matrix checks; the general operator proof requires separate substantive review.

Gram_and_list_factors.assurance: Exact finite Gram and falling-factorial formulas. No large-L harmless-root asymptotic is inferred from finite examples.

H6_u3_v3_r1_witness.contrast: Allowed by enlargement; excluded by the original both-unit population.

complete_root_densities.assurance: The first row is unimodular; the matrix need not be invertible when S shares H.

enlarged_boxes.assurance: Exact enlarged-root counts and half-open partitions; candidate asymptotic error is not certified.

enlarged_fourier.assurance: Exact bounded Fourier and gcd checks, including zero/nonunit coefficient cases; no analytic exponent is certified.
